name: ورشة النور
logline: شابان مخترعان يحاولان إصلاح مصباح طوارئ قبل أن تغرق الورشة والحي في الظلام.
synopsis: مسلسل مغامرات عائلي قصير يدور داخل ورشة صغيرة مليئة بالأدوات والاختراعات البسيطة. يعتمد على حل المشكلات والتعاون والمرح، مع قصص قابلة للإنتاج في عدد محدود من المواقع والشخصيات.

visual_style.art_direction: cinematic stylized 3D animation, original family-friendly character design, expressive human faces, soft rounded forms, clean readable silhouettes, detailed but production-efficient workshop props, no logos, no copyrighted characters
visual_style.line_style: clean soft-edged 3D forms with strong silhouettes
visual_style.lighting: warm practical workshop lights contrasted with cool storm light from the window

world_rules: All technology must look handmade from ordinary workshop parts.
No magic; every solution comes from observation, cooperation, and simple engineering.
Only Omar and Nader may appear in the first demo episode.
The complete episode stays inside the workshop location.
Keep hands and tool interactions simple enough for stable image-to-video generation.
continuity_notes: Omar always wears the teal work jacket and round glasses.
Nader always wears the orange hoodie and navy apron.
The emergency lamp is a small cream metal lantern with a teal handle.
The workbench layout and window position remain unchanged across shots.
